mechanics.claim: Toggle abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Toggle abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}

mechanics.claim: Only the first attack after switching to Fishbones benefits from Rev'd up bonus attack speed.
mechanics.quote: Only the first attack after switching to [[File:Switcheroo!.png|20px|link=]] Fishbones will benefit from [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] Rev'd up

mechanics.claim: Fishbones' primary-target damage is affected by critical strike modifiers, but the splash damage to surrounding enemies is proc damage that does not apply on-hit effects or life steal.
mechanics.quote: The damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: Fishbones splash damage is proc damage based on pre-mitigation damage to the primary target and does not apply life steal or on-hit effects.
mechanics.quote: It deals {{tip|proc damage}} and thus doesn't apply {{sti|{{as|life steal}}}} or {{tip|on-hit}} effects.

mechanics.claim: Fishbones attacks cost mana on-attack in addition to any normal attack cost.
Stacks of Rev'd up expire one at a time when their duration ends rather than all at once.
mechanics.quote: Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends.
